_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Find a wallet's public name

description: Use this when the user asks whether a wallet address has a public name, such as a token deployer or a known trader's wallet. Pass address (0x or Solana). Returns the ENS primary name when it resolves back to the address, and the Farcaster account that verified the address, both self-declared by the owner. It cannot search by a person's name and never links a wallet to a private person.

address.description: A wallet address: 0x... on an EVM chain, or a Solana address.

name: wallet_identity

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

source.description: Who the data comes from, to cite and to check it against.

title: Find a wallet's public name
